offers.uniquenessRationale: Navigation equipment belongs to Admiral's expedition-preparation identity. Any vanilla overlap is acceptable only as bounded first-contact mission preparation; Scorpion/Artem direct duplication is not intended.
Paracord is treated as bounded expedition support rather than generic barter stock. Any vanilla overlap is intentional; Scorpion/Artem direct duplication is not intended.
A handheld rangefinder is characteristic reconnaissance equipment for Admiral. Any vanilla overlap is accepted as a bounded specialist alternative; Scorpion/Artem direct duplication is not intended.
Field markers are mission-preparation consumables and fit Admiral's contract/logistics role. Vanilla duplication is expected and bounded; Scorpion/Artem trader duplication is not intended.
